name: greeting
answer: Halo! Saya asisten Customer Service Archeris. Saya siap membantu Anda seputar jadwal turnamen, scoring digital, aturan World Archery, profil atlet, pendaftaran, e-sertifikat, dan paket penyelenggara. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?
answer_en: Hello! I am the Archeris Customer Support assistant. I can assist you with tournament schedules, live digital scoring, World Archery rules, archer profiles, registration, e-certificates, and organizer packages. How can I help you today?

name: about_archeris
answer: Archeris adalah platform manajemen turnamen panahan dan sistem scoring digital modern berbasis web. Archeris menggantikan pencatatan kertas konvensional dengan input skor smartphone di garis tembak, pemeringkatan kualifikasi otomatis, bagan eliminasi World Archery, tiket QR, dan penerbitan e-sertifikat resmi.
answer_en: Archeris is a modern web-based archery tournament management and live digital scoring platform. It replaces paper scorecards with shooting line smartphone scoring, automated qualification rankings, World Archery elimination brackets, QR attendance ticketing, and verified digital certificates.

name: archeris_vs_ianseo
examples: mengapa archeris lebih baik dari ianseo
answer: Dibandingkan IanSEO, Archeris 100% berbasis cloud dan web responsive tanpa perlu instalasi software desktop, server lokal, atau konfigurasi database manual yang rumit. Archeris juga menyediakan pembayaran online otomatis, tiket QR absensi peserta, portal atlet dengan verifikasi e-sertifikat, dan antarmuka ramah smartphone yang siap pakai dalam hitungan menit.
answer_en: Compared to IanSEO, Archeris is 100% cloud & web-native with zero local software installations, manual servers, or complex DB setups. Archeris features automated online entry fee collection, digital QR check-in passes, public archer portfolios with verified QR certificates, and a mobile-friendly keypad ready to score in minutes.

name: world_archery_rules
examples_en: how is score calculated in archery
answer: Archeris sepenuhnya mematuhi standar resmi World Archery: mendukung nilai anak panah X, 10, 9 hingga M (Miss). Pada babak eliminasi Recurve & Barebow menggunakan Set System (2 poin per set menang, 1 poin seri, target 6 poin). Pada Compound menggunakan Cumulative Score (total 15 panah dari 5 seri). Jika seri, sistem mendukung 1-arrow shoot-off penentu kemenangan.
answer_en: Archeris strictly complies with official World Archery regulations: supporting arrow values X, 10, 9 down to M (Miss). In elimination matches, Recurve and Barebow use the Set System (2 set points for a win, 1 for tie, first to 6 points). Compound uses Cumulative Score (total of 15 arrows over 5 ends). Ties are resolved through 1-arrow shoot-offs with closest-to-center measurement.

name: scoring_methods
answer: Scoring di Archeris sangat mudah: scorekeeper membuka nomor bantalan pada smartphone, memasukkan nilai per anak panah (X, 10-1, M) menggunakan keypad warna interaktif, lalu menekan 'Konfirmasi Seri'. Total nilai, jumlah 10, dan X dihitung otomatis secara instan. Jika ada koreksi, panitia atau juri dapat memperbarui nilai lewat panel administrasi.
answer_en: Scoring on Archeris is effortless: scorekeepers open their assigned target lane on their smartphone, tap arrow values (X, 10-1, M) on the color-coded keypad, and press 'Confirm End'. Running totals, 10s, and Xs are tabulated automatically. Authorized judges and organizers can adjust scores with a full audit log if disputes arise.

name: scoring_offline
answer: Ya, Archeris dirancang khusus untuk kondisi lapangan terbuka. PWA (Progressive Web App) Archeris menyimpan data skor di perangkat lokal saat koneksi internet lemah atau terputus, lalu secara otomatis menyinkronkan seluruh nilai ke server pusat saat perangkat kembali online.
answer_en: Yes! Archeris is specifically engineered for outdoor tournament environments. Its progressive architecture caches scores locally on device storage during connection drops, automatically syncing all arrow data to the central leaderboard as soon as connectivity resumes.

name: scorekeeper_guide
answer: Scorekeeper ditugaskan oleh penyelenggara turnamen. Penyelenggara menambahkan akun scorekeeper dan membagikan jatah nomor bantalan (misal Bantalan 1-4). Scorekeeper cukup login dengan kredensial yang diberikan untuk langsung mengakses target tembak dan mencatat skor atlet.
answer_en: Scorekeepers are assigned by tournament organizers. In the organizer dashboard, admins assign scorekeepers to specific target butt ranges (e.g. Lanes 1 to 4). Scorekeepers log in with their credentials to immediately view target lists and enter live scores.

name: qualification_rounds
answer: Babak kualifikasi di Archeris mendukung format standar (seperti 2 sesi x 36 anak panah = 720 Round, atau format kustom). Skor dari setiap seri diakumulasikan untuk menentukan peringkat pemeringkatan (seeding) otomatis yang menjadi dasar bagan babak eliminasi.
answer_en: Qualification rounds in Archeris support standard international formats (such as 2 sessions x 36 arrows = 720 Round, or custom club configurations). Scores from every end are tabulated in real time to establish division seedings for the elimination brackets.

name: elimination_brackets
answer: Setelah babak kualifikasi selesai, Archeris menghasilkan bagan eliminasi otomatis sesuai peringkat kualifikasi (1/32, 1/16, 1/8, Perempat Final, Semifinal, Perunggu, dan Emas). Pemenang setiap match otomatis maju ke babak berikutnya hingga perebutan podium juara.
answer_en: Once qualification scores are finalized, Archeris automatically generates seeded elimination brackets (1/32, 1/16, 1/8, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Bronze, and Gold medal matches). Match winners automatically advance through the bracket up to the podium finals.

name: tournament_creation
answer: Untuk membuat turnamen: Masuk ke Dashboard Penyelenggara > Turnamen > Buat Turnamen. Masukkan judul, tanggal, lokasi, deskripsi, dan flyer. Tambahkan kategori lomba (seperti Recurve 70m, Compound 50m, Barebow 20m), atur kuota serta biaya pendaftaran, lalu klik Publikasikan.
answer_en: To create a tournament: Navigate to Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments > Create Tournament. Enter event title, dates, venue, and banner. Configure division categories (e.g. Recurve 70m, Compound 50m, Barebow U-15), set participant quotas and entry fees, and publish your public registration page.

name: pricing_packages
answer: Archeris menyediakan paket fleksibel: 1) Starter Free (Gratis 1 kuota turnamen maks 50 peserta untuk uji coba), 2) Standard EO (Promo Rp 24.999 / $1.50 per turnamen hingga 200 peserta), dan 3) Elite EO (Promo Rp 39.999 / $3.50 per turnamen peserta tak terbatas). Kuota yang dibeli tersimpan di saldo organisasi dan tidak memiliki batas kedaluwarsa.
answer_en: Archeris offers transparent, flexible pricing: 1) Starter Free (1 free tournament quota up to 50 participants for testing), 2) Standard EO (Promo Rp 24,999 / $1.50 per event up to 200 archers), and 3) Elite EO (Promo Rp 39,999 / $3.50 per event with unlimited participants). Quotas stored in your balance never expire.

name: registration_help
answer: Untuk mendaftar lomba: Buka menu Turnamen, pilih event yang ingin diikuti, klik 'Daftar Sekarang', pilih divisi kategori lomba (misal Recurve Men), pilih/isi data atlet dan klub, lalu selesaikan pembayaran. Setelah berhasil, Anda akan menerima e-tiket dengan QR absensi.
answer_en: To register for an event: Browse the Tournaments directory, select your desired competition, click 'Register Now', choose your division category (e.g. Recurve Men), verify your archer profile and club, and complete online checkout. Once confirmed, you will receive an official digital e-ticket with QR check-in pass.

name: eticket_qr_checkin
examples_en: how to check in at venue
answer: Setiap pendaftaran yang telah lunas otomatis mendapatkan E-Tiket Digital dilengkapi QR Code verifikasi. Saat tiba di lokasi turnamen, atlet cukup menunjukkan QR Code ini pada smartphone ke panitia meja registrasi untuk absensi instan dan pengambilan nomor dada / ID card.
answer_en: Every confirmed tournament registration automatically generates a verified Digital E-Ticket with a unique QR Code. Upon arriving at the competition venue, archers present this QR code on their smartphone to the desk committee for instant check-in and bib number collection.

name: score_tracking
answer: Hasil skor dan leaderboard tersedia secara real-time di halaman detail event menu 'Result'. Anda bisa memfilter ranking kualifikasi per kategori, melihat rincian anak panah per seri, serta memantau perkembangan bagan eliminasi hingga perebutan medali.
answer_en: Live scores and standings are updated in real time under the 'Results' tab of each tournament page. You can filter qualification leaderboards by division, inspect arrow-by-arrow end totals, and track live elimination brackets.

name: certificates_pdf
answer: Atlet dapat mengunduh E-Sertifikat resmi beresolusi tinggi langsung dari Dashboard Atlet > Sertifikat atau profil publik. Setiap sertifikat dilengkapi QR Code verifikasi unik yang dapat dipindai untuk membuktikan keaslian prestasi. Penyelenggara juga dapat mencetak Buku Hasil (Result Book) resmi dalam format PDF.
answer_en: Archers can download high-resolution official E-Certificates directly from Archer Dashboard > Certificates or their public profile. Each certificate features a tamper-proof QR verification code. Organizers can also generate comprehensive official PDF Result Books.

name: payment_methods
answer: Archeris mendukung berbagai metode pembayaran online instan: QRIS (GoPay, OVO, Dana, ShopeePay, BCA dsb), Virtual Account bank nasional (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Permata), Kartu Kredit/Debit, dan PayPal untuk atlet atau penyelenggara internasional.
answer_en: Archeris supports comprehensive automated instant payment methods: QRIS (e-wallets & banking apps), National Bank Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Permata), Credit/Debit Cards, and PayPal for international participants.

name: invoice_receipts
answer: Invoice dan bukti pembayaran resmi dapat diakses di menu Dashboard > Pembayaran / Pendaftaran. Setelah status 'Paid', Anda dapat menekan tombol 'Download PDF' untuk mengunduh kuitansi resmi.
answer_en: Official invoices and payment receipts are available in your Dashboard under Payments / My Registrations. Once marked as 'Paid', click 'Download PDF' to save your official tax/billing receipt.

name: archer_profile
answer: Anda dapat mengelola profil lengkap pemanah di Dashboard Atlet > Profil: memperbarui foto avatar, foto banner, biografi diri, spesifikasi busur/alat, asal klub, tautan media sosial, serta menyematkan sorotan prestasi kejuaraan.
answer_en: You can manage your complete archer portfolio in Archer Dashboard > Profile: update profile avatar, banner, athlete bio, bow equipment specifications, club affiliation, social links, and pin featured championship achievements.

name: club_contingent
answer: Atlet dapat memilih klub yang sudah terdaftar atau menambahkan nama klub baru secara langsung saat memperbarui profil atau mendaftar turnamen. Klub akan tercantum di papan peringkat dan statistik resmi turnamen.
answer_en: Archers can select from registered archery clubs or submit a new club affiliation when updating their profile or registering for events. Club origin is displayed across leaderboards, bracket cards, and tournament statistics.

name: account_security
answer: Jika lupa kata sandi, klik 'Lupa Password' pada halaman login dan masukkan email Anda untuk menerima instruksi reset. Anda juga bisa masuk secara instan menggunakan tombol 'Login with Google'.
answer_en: If you forgot your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and submit your registered email to receive reset instructions. You can also sign in instantly using 'Continue with Google'.

name: bantuan_teknis
answer: Jika mengalami kendala teknis atau error sistem, silakan muat ulang halaman (refresh) atau periksa koneksi internet. Jika kendala berlanjut, hubungi tim support melalui halaman Kontak atau email ke admin@archeris.net disertai tangkapan layar (screenshot).
answer_en: If you encounter technical issues or errors, try refreshing the page and verifying your connection. If the issue persists, reach out via our Contact page or email admin@archeris.net with error details and screenshots for fast resolution.

name: contact_support
answer: Anda dapat menghubungi tim Archeris melalui: 1) Halaman Kontak di website, 2) Email: admin@archeris.net, atau 3) Telepon: +62 21 575 8888 (Senin-Jumat 09:00 - 17:00 WIB). Tim kami siap mendampingi turnamen Anda!
answer_en: You can reach the Archeris team via: 1) Website Contact form, 2) Email: admin@archeris.net, or 3) Phone: +62 21 575 8888 (Mon-Fri 09:00 - 17:00 WIB). We are always happy to support your tournament operations!

name: refund_policy
answer: Kebijakan pengembalian dana (refund) untuk pendaftaran turnamen diatur langsung oleh Penyelenggara Turnamen (EO) masing-masing sesuai ketentuan di petunjuk teknis (Juknis). Jika turnamen dibatalkan resmi oleh EO, proses refund akan dikoordinasikan oleh panitia penyelenggara.
answer_en: Refund policies for tournament entry fees are governed directly by the respective Tournament Organizer (EO) as stated in the event technical handbook. If an event is officially cancelled by the organizer, refund disbursement will be coordinated accordingly.
